Body.Content:
Azure Maps (formerly Azure Location Based Services) is a set of geospatial service APIs for developers that bring location context to the Internet of Things (IoT) and other datasets. Easily incorporate maps, search, routing, traffic, and other location information directly into your apps.

Azure Maps is now generally available. General availability pricing began on May 7, 2018. See the following table for name change details.
